name: Scope & Interface
short: Define what must be delivered, where boundaries sit, and who carries each interface.
description: The physical, functional and responsibility boundaries of the Works, including access, information, design responsibility and interfaces.

name: Time
short: Model the planned time baseline and the routes by which it may move.
description: The contractual time baseline, progress controls, delay allocation and mechanisms for extending or accelerating performance.

name: Payment & Price
short: Connect the agreed price baseline with valuation, certification and adjustment.
description: The price and measurement baseline, interim payment machinery and mechanisms that adjust the amount payable.

name: Risk Allocation
short: Locate responsibility for physical, legal and external project risks.
description: Allocation of defined project risks, including exceptional events, site conditions, care of the Works and insurance.

name: Liability & Remedies
short: Trace default, responsibility, relief and available contractual responses.
description: The consequences of non-performance, allocation of loss, indemnities and the contractual remedies available to each party.

name: Claims & Disputes
short: Follow entitlement from notice through determination and dispute resolution.
description: Procedural pathways for claims, Engineer determinations, dispute avoidance and formal dispute resolution.

name: Contract Mechanics
short: Understand the administrative rules that keep the contract operating.
description: Notices, communications, assignment, compliance, defined roles and other operating machinery of the contract.
